blogs.title: Why schools outgrow spreadsheets
blogs.excerpt: Three signs it is time to move student records out of shared sheets, and what to move first.
body: Shared spreadsheets work until the second person edits them. Then attendance, fees and results start to disagree with each other.
Start with the records that change daily, usually attendance, and move them first. Give each role only the screen it needs.

blogs.title: Tool calling, without the magic
blogs.excerpt: How an agent decides which tool to call, and how we keep that decision predictable.
body: An agent chooses a tool by reading its name, its description and its inputs. Clear descriptions make the choice predictable.
We keep the tool list short, type every input, and log each call so a person can review what the agent did.

blogs.title: Designing an SDK people finish reading
blogs.excerpt: Small surface, honest errors, one working example on the first page.
body: A good SDK has a small surface. Every extra option is something a new user has to read before they succeed.
Put one working example on the first page, and make errors say what to change.
